# Read fixtures: sources

Every fixture in this folder was written for wikeeper. None holds third-party
content. Names, dates and figures are illustrative.

- `article.html`: a status page with a nav menu, headings, a list, a table and a footer.
- `app-shell.html`: an empty JavaScript app shell.
- `notes.md`: a short markdown note.
- `table.csv`: a three-column sheet with a quoted field that holds a comma.
